Problem: find the least number must be subtracted from 105829 so that remaining no . is divisible by 21 ?

<reflection>
We are given the number 105829 and need to find the least number to subtract so the remaining number is divisible by 21. Subtracting x from 105829 to make it divisible by 21 means 105829 - x ≡ 0 (mod 21). This congruence implies x ≡ 105829 (mod 21).
The least nonnegative number to subtract is not the GCD; it is the remainder when 105829 is divided by 21, i.e., the smallest nonnegative solution to x ≡ 105829 (mod 21).
Compute 105829 mod 21 correctly and use that remainder as the least number to subtract.
